jei.ad_ssc.moon_dust_ore.info: Moon Dust Ore generates on the three Curse Satellites and the Curse Moon. Silk Touch preserves its origin, including when moved or placed again. Smelting plain ore yields 1 Untreated Moondust; ore from the outer, middle and inner satellites and the Curse Moon yields 2, 3, 4 and 5 respectively. Check the smelting recipe for the matching origin.
jei.ad_ssc.morphscale_suit.info: Morph-Scale space suits can be worn while transformed by SSC and retain the functions of their Ad Astra counterparts. Upgrade a suit with a Morphscale Core and Untreated Moondust at a smithing table. Morph-Scale Netherite Space Suits also have crafting upgrades to Morph-Scale Jet Suits.
